checks.title: DBSV statutes, June 2022 version
checks.check_result: Broad constituency includes blindness/visual impairment, disease that can lead to impairment or blindness, and additional disabilities. Interests are not identical to member numbers.
checks.limits: The organisation’s own rules are primary evidence of its remit, not independent epidemiological evidence.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note, not original source bytes

checks.title: Official BITV 2.0, last amended 24 October 2023
checks.check_result: Scope, perceivable/operable/understandable/robust standards and declaration requirements verified. Declaration must specify compatibility and assessment method; it is updated yearly or on material change.
checks.limits: Federal regulation is not silently equated with every Länder implementing rule. Existing duties do not make a request for an explicit ordinance reference erroneous.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note, not original source bytes

checks.title: DOG Whitebook 2023
checks.read_extent: Physical pp. 12–13 (printed 10–11), relevant AMD methods/table; reference entries 8–12 on physical p. 59
checks.check_result: 2017 extrapolations give 6,981,000 early and 488,000 late AMD, including early disease without current subjective visual impairment. Age bounds, sampling years and classification differences are explicit.
checks.limits: Only relevant passages of the 72-page background book read. This supports a historical model scale, not an independently enumerated composite September 2026 unique-person count; overlapping disorders must not be added.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note, not original source bytes

checks.title: Woche des Sehens / original model authors: German eye-disease estimates
checks.read_extent: Complete substantive counts, methods, definitions, sources and author/date sections via official web-tool extraction
checks.check_result: Original authors describe 2017 population extrapolation using age-specific international/meta-analytic data calibrated against regional GHS findings; stage definitions vary and early disease counts can include no present impairment.
checks.limits: Direct current route returned 404, but the historical original route yielded indexed primary content. Published October 2018, updated September 2020; DBSV coauthor means model provenance, not independent confirmation of the 2026 statement. No original-byte hash claimed for extraction.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note from tool extraction

checks.title: Korb et al., primary GHS AMD study, 2014
checks.read_extent: Publisher metadata and complete accessible abstract: background, methods, results and conclusions
checks.check_result: A regional single-centre population cohort aged 35–74; 4,340 photographs independently graded by two ophthalmologists; 11.9 percent early and 0.2 percent late AMD. Sample and age limits differ from national disease-at-risk constituency.
checks.limits: Full body is subscription-restricted and was not read. PubMed web/shell returned an empty/challenge-like response and is not affirmative evidence; publisher abstract supplies the actual completed check.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note from tool extraction

checks.title: Schuster et al., Ophthalmology 2019—where do we stand?
checks.read_extent: Publisher metadata, accessible German/English abstract and references 8–10, 25
checks.check_result: Identifies limited German population data and changing age structure; citation 25 points to the original extrapolation authors and definitions.
checks.limits: Full text subscription-restricted; not presented as a complete independent recalculation of every model step or a current national census.

checks.title: DOG September 2025 primary clinical-society statement
checks.read_extent: Physical p. 1, header and prevalence paragraph
checks.check_result: Roughly seven million AMD cases are described across disease forms; cataract can coexist, so disease counts are not simply additive.
checks.limits: A broad rounded clinical estimate supports plausibility, not a deduplicated exact September 2026 threshold or blindness-only denominator.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note from tool extraction

checks.title: W3C WCAG 2.1, recommendation dated 6 May 2025
checks.read_extent: Header/status; success criteria 2.1.1 Keyboard and 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
checks.check_result: Required keyboard operation and accessible input instructions substantiate the technical nature of the declaration’s keyboard/label defects.
checks.limits: Selected normative criteria only, not entire standard or fresh live-service testing. Legal conformity also depends on applicable harmonised standards and implementing rules; WCAG alone is not a complete all-Länder legal audit.
checks.archive_type: Authored concise primary-check note from tool extraction

checks.title: Hamburg eWA transaction-service accessibility declaration
checks.read_extent: All three original physical pages independently read from verified temporary original PDF
checks.check_result: Covers actual serviceportal EWA entry, not merely marketing site. April 2026 assessment and 22 April review state partial compatibility; keyboard controls, screen-reader labels/structure and PDF tagging defects are concrete. Planned repairs are not completed compliance.
checks.limits: Provider declaration supports the explicitly attributed claim. No independent September immutable capture, current live retest or claim all blind users cannot use any feature. Original temporary PDF supplied by B was independently read; no duplicate full archive retained.

storage_policy: Concise authored source checks retained. New public downloads are temporary and removed only after counterpart/root follow-up. No copied full source archive.
